item.title: CVE-2026-85413 [CVSS:3.1 6.4 MEDIUM]
item.description:
The Foxtool All-in-One: Contact chat button, Custom login, Media optimize images plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'foxtool_image_id' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A subscriber-level attacker can store a payload in their own profile's foxtoolpic user-meta that executes in an administrator's browser session when the administrator views the user via the Users → Edit screen.
Score: 6.4 (MEDIUM) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N

item.title: CVE-2026-22311 [CVSS:4.0 8.7 HIGH]
item.description:
The failed-login limiter of the JTL-Wawi synchronisation interface of JTL-Shop derives the client identity from the client-controlled X-Forwarded-For header and counts requests without credentials as failed logins. An unauthenticated remote attacker can block the synchronisation between JTL-Shop and JTL-Wawi with a few requests and repeat this indefinitely, so that orders are no longer handed over to JTL-Wawi. No data is disclosed and no code is executed.
Score: 8.7 (HIGH) Vector: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X

item.title: CVE-2026-132128 [CVSS:3.1 7.4 HIGH]
CVE-2026-125061 [CVSS:4.0 8.5 HIGH]
item.description:
The administration page "Offene Bestellungen" (open orders) of the JTL PayPal Checkout plugin for JTL-Shop outputs the customer name of pending orders without output encoding. A registered customer (free self-registration) can submit an HTML-entity-encoded name, which is decoded to markup when the billing address of an order is written. If the PayPal payment is left unfinished, the order is listed on the page and the name is rendered as markup in the browser of an administrator who opens the page. The script code runs with the privileges of that administrator and can, for example, create a new administrator account. Guest orders are not affected, because the name is encoded again.

item.title: CVE-2026-125060 [CVSS:4.0 8.8 HIGH]
item.description:
The checkout of JTL-Shop stores the delivery address ID submitted by the customer in the session and adopts it into the order without verifying that the address belongs to the ordering customer. A remote attacker with access to the checkout, including a guest, can thereby attach the delivery address of another customer to their own order. Name and address of the other customer, and depending on the shop configuration further contact data, then appear in the order confirmation and customer account. As the IDs are sequential, addresses can be enumerated. Goods may also be shipped to the wrong address.

item.title: CVE-2026-123972 [CVSS:3.1 7.2 HIGH]
item.description:
The WP-Slimbox2 Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a logged-in user, typically an administrator, to click the attacker's image link in the comment; however, because unmoderated comments appear in the WordPress moderation queue where administrators routinely interact with them, the moderation gate does not meaningfully prevent exploitation. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.
Score: 7.2 (HIGH) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N

item.title: CVE-2026-123971 [CVSS:3.1 6.4 MEDIUM]

item.description:
The Fancy Lightbox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-123968 [CVSS:3.1 7.2 HIGH]
item.description:
The Slimbox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment (anchor title within comment HTML)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. WordPress core comment KSES permits unauthenticated commenters to post anchor elements with href and title attributes, so an entity-encoded payload stored in the title attribute survives sanitization verbatim; the browser then decodes the entities when populating the DOM .title property, and the Slimbox library's jQuery .html() caption sink renders it as executable HTML.
Score: 7.2 (HIGH) Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N

item.title: CVE-2026-133001 [CVSS:4.0 5.3 MEDIUM]
item.description:
FlowIntel contains an authorization flaw in its duplicate alert ingestion logic. When a duplicate alert is received and its content is updated, the ownership and visibility scope fields (owner user and owner organization) were not refreshed to reflect the connector's current scope. As a result, an alert that was originally created under a broader visibility scope retained that broader scope even after the connector's scope was narrowed or changed.
This means that users or organizations that should no longer have visibility into a given alert could continue to access it, because the stale ownership fields were never updated during the duplicate-update path. The issue affected all duplicate updates, including those involving alerts in terminal review states and those recovered from uniqueness conflicts.
Security impact: - Unauthorized disclosure of security alert content to users or organizations outside the intended visibility scope. - Stale access persists indefinitely until the alert is independently re-scoped or deleted.
Affected version: <4.1.0.
Score: 5.3 (MEDIUM) Vector: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X
